(deftype TransientArrayMap [^:mutable ^boolean editable_QMARK_
                            ^:mutable len
                            arr]
  ICounted
  (-count [tcoll]
    (if editable_QMARK_
      (quot len 2)
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "count after persistent!"))))

  ILookup
  (-lookup [tcoll k]
    (-lookup tcoll k nil))

  (-lookup [tcoll k not-found]
    (if editable_QMARK_
      (let [idx (array-map-index-of tcoll k)]
        (if (== idx -1)
          not-found
          (aget arr (inc idx))))
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "lookup after persistent!"))))

  ITransientCollection
  (-conj! [tcoll o]
    (if editable_QMARK_
      (cond
        (map-entry? o)
        (-assoc! tcoll (key o) (val o))

        (vector? o)
        (-assoc! tcoll (o 0) (o 1))

        :else
        (loop [es (seq o) tcoll tcoll]
          (let [hamt-bootstrap-iflet-1 (first es)] (if hamt-bootstrap-iflet-1 (let [e hamt-bootstrap-iflet-1] (recur (next es)
                   (-assoc! tcoll (key e) (val e)))) tcoll))))
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "conj! after persistent!"))))

  (-persistent! [tcoll]
    (if editable_QMARK_
      (do (set! editable_QMARK_ false)
          (PersistentArrayMap. nil (quot len 2) arr nil))
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "persistent! called twice"))))

  ITransientAssociative
  (-assoc! [tcoll key val]
    (if editable_QMARK_
      (let [idx (array-map-index-of tcoll key)]
        (if (== idx -1)
          (if (<= (+ len 2) (* 2 (.-HASHMAP_THRESHOLD PersistentArrayMap)))
            (do (set! len (+ len 2))
                (.push arr key)
                (.push arr val)
                tcoll)
            (assoc! (array->transient-hash-map len arr) key val))
          (if (identical? val (aget arr (inc idx)))
            tcoll
            (do (aset arr (inc idx) val)
                tcoll))))
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "assoc! after persistent!"))))

  ITransientMap
  (-dissoc! [tcoll key]
    (if editable_QMARK_
      (let [idx (array-map-index-of tcoll key)]
        (when (>= idx 0)
          (aset arr idx (aget arr (- len 2)))
          (aset arr (inc idx) (aget arr (dec len)))
          (let [hamt-bootstrap-doto-2 arr] (.pop hamt-bootstrap-doto-2) (.pop hamt-bootstrap-doto-2) hamt-bootstrap-doto-2)
          (set! len (- len 2)))
        tcoll)
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "dissoc! after persistent!"))))

  IFn
  (-invoke [tcoll key]
    (-lookup tcoll key nil))
  (-invoke [tcoll key not-found]
    (-lookup tcoll key not-found)))
